This directory preserves the fixed official Swift Apache license with Runtime Library Exception, source provenance/ABI contract and the exact app-written source files of the isolated iPad-proven two-entry adapter.

The compatibility entry code authenticates the modern external context PAC and delegates decoding/metadata state handling to the genuinely identified old stock Core. It does not contain a migrated Swift27 parser. Project changes only rename host source/includes and former source-only labels; proven function bodies and old128-byte entry pins remain unchanged. The private developer builder uses old_entry_pins.h and exports.list here. No global registry, system replacement or automatic production linkage is added. See host modern_swift_lookup_compat.md for actual evidence and limits.
